video_title: Blake Griffin on Becoming the John Oliver of Sports and Wanting to Join the Strike Force Five

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the challenges of being a critical NBA analyst
quotes.excerpt: I honestly didn't want to, mostly just because I felt like guys are so critical of players.
quotes.quote: I honestly didn't want to, mostly just because I felt like guys are so critical of players. As a player, you go play as hard as you possibly can, and then critics are like, 'This guy sucks.' I was trying. So when I signed on to do it, I wanted to try to do it a different way. Be a little bit uplifting, still give analysis, but teach the game.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the difficulty of criticizing former teammates
quotes.excerpt: It's like if your friend messed up and you had to go on national TV.
quotes.quote: It's tough. It's like if your friend messed up and you had to go on national TV and be like, 'This guy sucks.' No, there's a way to do it. I definitely get some texts, I get some calls. There are open lines of communication.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the challenges of reading a teleprompter
quotes.excerpt: John Oliver just got to read from a teleprompter for 30 minutes. And now I do that.
quotes.quote: John Oliver just got to read from a teleprompter for 30 minutes. And now I do that, but I played basketball, and that's not basketball player strength, reading. I don't know what made me think I could do this, but it's been a blast. I grew up watching late night and love John Oliver, love comedy in general.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the reactionary nature of sports media
quotes.excerpt: Sports is so reactionary because there's games all the time.
quotes.quote: Sports is so reactionary because there's games all the time. So the next morning you have to go on and you update people on what happened and who played well. The reason it's named The Step Back is because we're literally taking a step back and not being just rushing to judgment on these issues, doing our research, putting together a script, and trying to make people laugh.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on finding out about his trade via Twitter
quotes.excerpt: I was playing on the trampoline with my kids and I look at my phone.
quotes.quote: I was playing on the trampoline with my kids and I had an idea that it might go down. I look at my phone and it was, 'Blake Griffin has been traded from the Los Angeles Clippers to the Detroit Pistons.' I was like, 'All right, Daddy's turn. Let's go.'

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the challenges of coaching his own children
quotes.excerpt: Kids don't listen, even when you played professionally.
quotes.quote: I haven't done games, but I have helped out in practice, and man, kids don't listen, even when you played professionally. They're very respectful, but I think sports and life in general, you have to learn through mistakes. You have to go through them. If I tell them something, it's not really going to click until you experience it. So figuring out how to coach, it's been brutal.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the importance of parents officiating youth games
quotes.excerpt: I had a basketball camp that I had to officiate a game for.
quotes.quote: I had a basketball camp that I had to officiate a game for. So all the kids are at the Blake Griffin Basketball Camp, and these kids hated me. And I was like, 'You know what? I got to be nicer to refs. This is happening, I'm turning over a new leaf.' And it didn't happen. I don't know if you saw my career, but a lot of technical fouls.

quotes.speaker: Seth Meyers
quotes.summary_phrase: Seth Meyers and Blake Griffin discuss joining the Strike Force Five

text_blocks.speaker: Seth Meyers
text_blocks.text: We do have a Strike Force Five text chain. We gave Colbert like one year to find a new show. So I guess that's, I would just say that if in a year he's no longer a talk show host.

text_blocks.speaker: Blake Griffin
text_blocks.text: So okay. Am I like the sixth man? Am I like next up?

text_blocks.speaker: Seth Meyers
text_blocks.text: If you're willing to come off the bench and be a sixth man, we would happily add you to the text chain.
